reading.scope: Sections 4-5 and verifier-noise discussion; targeted method/evaluation reading.
claims: Perturbing the initial generated-token embedding and greedily decoding creates a continuous search interface; Bayesian optimization uses same-model verification and coherence rewards.
controls_to_borrow: Separate random perturbation from adaptive search and selection; charge generator/verifier calls and compare first-token sampling at equal budgets.

reading.scope: Sections 3-4, 6 Limitations and Appendix B selection protocol; targeted full-method reading.
claims: A controlled three-signal/two-estimator comparison finds different rankings for detection and intervention across 15 tasks and three models.
controls_to_borrow: Separate train/validation/test splits, test strengthening and weakening, constrain unrelated language-model loss, and audit whether targets enter the extraction signal.
